title: Account Tenure Share on Fleet Home Delivery: Training Questions and Answers
content:
**Training note, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement home delivery fee**

A long-standing commercial customer pays a tenure share of the fleet home delivery fee. The share is set by the age of the buyer's active service account under **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**, read from that account's opening date and status.

## Rule

| Age of the buyer's active service account at the handling date | Tenure share of the fee |
|---|---|
| Opened at least 60 whole months before | 0.85 (85 percent) |
| Opened at least 24 but fewer than 60 whole months before | 0.95 (95 percent) |
| Opened fewer than 24 whole months before | none (whole fee) |
| No service account in active status | none (whole fee) |

A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

## Questions and answers

**What record sets the age?**
The opening date of the buyer's service account that is in active status, counted in whole months up to the handling date.

**What if the account is on credit hold or closed?**
Then the buyer has no active service account and pays the whole fee.

**Where do the edges of each tier fall?**
Take an account opened on the 18th of a month.
- On the 18th of the month exactly 60 months later, 60 whole months have been reached and the share is 0.85.
- On the 17th of that month, only 59 whole months have passed and the share is 0.95.
- At 24 months the same edge applies: on the 18th, 24 whole months give 0.95; on the 17th, 23 whole months mean the whole fee.

**Hypothetical example.**
An account opened 37 whole months before the handling date carries a share of 0.95. A fee of 210.00 on that account's unit would therefore be carried at 199.50.
